a.title: Google will now let any AI agent run your smart home

b.lede: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.
b.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
